title: kdiab-bff: Backend-for-Frontend with analytics dashboard
description: New kdiab-bff service aggregating measures, treatments, and profiles into a unified analytics frontend. Features: combined CGM+treatment timeline chart, HbA1c/TIR analytics, AGP (ambulatory glucose profile by hour), profiles viewer. Stack: Kotlin/Ktor backend (stateless, HTTP clients to upstream services), React+Recharts frontend. Ports: backend 8083, frontend 3003.
close_reason: kdiab-bff service fully implemented: backend (services, routes, HTTP clients, domain, plugins, Application.kt, Dockerfile) and frontend (App.tsx, Tab nav, TimelineChart, AgpChart, HbA1cCard, TimeInRangeBar, ProfilesTable, i18n, Recharts)

title: add ACTIVITY treatment type with name, duration, intensity
description: Add a new TreatmentType ACTIVITY for physical activity tracking. Fields: name (string, e.g. 'running', 'jogging'), duration (minutes, integer), intensity (enum: low/moderate/high). Changes span: kdiab-treatments/api/openapi.yaml, backend domain model TreatmentType enum, Liquibase migration (if needed for DB constraint), frontend form in TreatmentForm.tsx, i18n labels, and seed data.

title: add pagination to measures list
description: The measures list fetches all records at once causing long load times. Add server-side pagination: extend GET /users/{userId}/measures in openapi.yaml with page/size query params, implement in backend route + service, update frontend MeasureList.tsx to use paginated queries with infinite scroll or page controls.

title: fix seed data: use Kohlenhydrate instead of BEhandlung
description: The pg-seed treatment entries contain German label 'BEhandlung' (or it appears in treatment notes/type labels). Replace with the correct German term 'Kohlenhydrate' for CARBS entries. Investigate config/postgres/02-seed-data.sql and kdiab-treatments frontend i18n.

title: add profiles tab to BFF analytics view
description: The BFF analytics view shows profiles in a table inside the analytics tab. Move them to a dedicated Profiles tab at the same level as the Analytics tab, so glucose stats and profile config don't compete for space. kdiab-bff/frontend/src/App.tsx has the tab structure; kdiab-bff/frontend/src/features/analytics/AnalyticsView.tsx and ProfilesTable.tsx have the data.

title: rename Messmanager to Messungen in measures frontend
description: The app title and welcome message in kdiab-measures uses 'Messmanager' which is not standard German. Rename to 'Messungen' (measurements). Changes needed in kdiab-measures/frontend/src/i18n/locales/de.json lines 3 and 5.
